effect.name: Dissolve
effect.description: Eats the image away in random blocks, with a burning edge. Works as a death effect on a sprite and as a scene transition on a layer, and because the blocks are square it stays honest on a pixel grid.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Edge Colour
parameter.description: Colour of the band at the dissolve front.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: 0 is untouched, 1 is completely gone. Animate this.

parameter.name: Block Size
parameter.description: Size of one dissolve block in texels. 1 is per-pixel static, larger reads as chunks falling away.

parameter.name: Edge Width
parameter.description: How wide the coloured burning band is. 0 removes it.

parameter.name: Seed
parameter.description: Changes which blocks go first. Any two objects with different seeds dissolve differently.

parameter.name: Reverse
parameter.description: On makes the object appear instead of disappear as Amount rises.
